description: rx guard: a Bash command that runs `ray publish` / `npm run publish` is allowed only behind a current `rx gates` receipt and `rx audit record` audit; `gh pr ready` in any form is always blocked (marking ready is Chris's click); a Write, Edit, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit into a repo's `.git/rx/` state or the rx attestation key is blocked, and so is a Bash command that mentions either (rx state is written only by rx). Format per https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference (exec form: `args` present, so the ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} path is one argument with no shell quoting). `onFailure: block` (Claude Code 2.1.295+) fails closed when the hook process itself cannot run or times out.
